notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.7
notes.notes:
[b]CORE[/b]

[b]Added:[/b]
[list]
[*] Global and Friends Steam Leaderboards for Endless Mode
[*] New Code Redeem functionality for claiming custom rewards
[/list]

[b]MENU UI[/b]

[b]Updated:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved Settings Panel navigation
[*] The redeem code button will display an animation when entering an invalid code
[*] The tooltip in the crafting panel is bigger
[/list]

[b]GAMEPLAY:[/b]

[b]Added:[/b]
[list]
[*] The Pickaxe count panel will provide feedback when attempting to use the Pickaxe without charges
[*] Fade In effect on start
[/list]
[b]Updated:[/b]
[list]
[*] In-game tutorials have been simplified to communicate only the most important messages
[*] Tutorial dialogues will no longer pause the game
[*] Menu Song 2 will also play during gameplay
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b]
[list]
[*] Timer remaining on screen after destroying the Pinata
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.5
notes.notes:
[b]CORE[/b]

[b]Added:[/b]
[list]
[*] Steam Leaderboards for Endless Mode
[/list]
[b]Updated:[/b]
[list]
[*] The price for the HP Token consumable has been adjusted to 150 coins
[*] Running more than one instance of the game is not possible anymore
[/list]

[b]MENU UI[/b]

[b]Fixed:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed volume sliders not interactable through controller/keyboard
[/list]

[b]GAMEPLAY:[/b]

[b]Added:[/b]
[list]
[*] Adjusted Game Area size to support multiple screen aspect ratios: 5:3 / 16:9 / 16:10 / 17:9 / 21:9
[/list]
[b]Updated:[/b]
[list]
[*] Touching a Biome Drone in Endless Mode will result in an explosion that will destroy nearby enemies
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b]
[list]
[*] COMBO burn-effect not being applied to some objects
[*] Performance improvements in levels with a large number of enemies
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.2
notes.notes:
[b]CORE[/b]

[b]Added:[/b]
[list]
[*] Support for DualSense controllers
[*] A new tutorial will play right after unlocking endless mode (works retroactively as well)
[/list]
[b]Updated:[/b]
[list]
[*] The level for unlocking endless mode has changed from 20 to 3
-- Retroactive unlocks will be provided to players who are between level 4 and 20
[*] Credits have been updated
[*] Updated the required coins to purchase Tech-o Chests
[/list]

[b]MENU UI[/b]

[b]Added:[/b]
[list]
[*] Scroll navigation to Credits Panel
[*] Expand animation to Navigation Highlight
[/list]
[b]Updated:[/b]
[list]
[*] Crafting Panel will only display the necessary materials for each upgrade
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed navigation on Crafting Tutorial
[*] Fixed chest opening taking too long to display OK button
[/list]

[b]GAMEPLAY:[/b]

[b]Added:[/b]
[list]
[*] Game will now pause when a controller is disconnected
[*] Game will now pause when the Steam Overlay is opened
[/list]
[b]Updated:[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced Crit shot SFX by 25%
[*] Collectible Magnet Drone timer will only deplete if the player is not using the Magnet Weapon
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed Multiple background songs playing after unlocking Endless Mode
[*] Filler groups with biome drones will contain the proper biomes now
[*] The pink saw drone in level 57 will be shown correctly
[*] The loot dropped by Piñatas should work properly on slo-mo now
[*] Normal level progression will continue after Piñatas leaves due to time-out
[*] The Piñatas will play the destroyed animation when defeated
[*] Biome switch VFX instantiation has been optimized
-- Effects will be pooled
-- Only the touched biome switch will result in an explosion that can destroy other enemies
[*] Collectables will no longer be hindered if an enemy drops more than 3
[/list]
[b]Removed:[/b]
[list]
[*] Movement mode switch debug button
[/list]

notes.notes:
Muchacho Bean is finally being released after 11 years of development!
Join Voorny and the developers for a chance to win a free game key!

The stream will be starting soon.

Let's celebrate the release together, Muchachos!

Be a Muchacho and join us on this adventure!
